Task title: Create the Flutter monorepo with the five layer packages
Description: Create one repository holding the app and its shared packages, following the five-layer stack: `app_pdf` (screens, tool grid, viewer, file manager, paywall, Riverpod providers), `doc_tools` (one ToolJob per feature, progress stream, cancel, undo snapshot, workflow runner; pure Dart, worker isolates), `doc_core` (open/save/render PDFs, page ops, text extraction, image pipeline, OCR text-layer writer), `doc_vision` (scanner flows, edge detection, OCR engines, layout, document-in-photo detection) and `ai_core` (imported from Sogda: model manager, LLM arbiter, translation engines, embeddings, retrieval). - `flutter analyze` and `dart test` pass in every package from a clean clone
- Package dependency direction is one-way: app_pdf → doc_tools → doc_core / doc_vision → ai_core (no cycles, enforced by a lint script)
- README describes the layer responsibilities in the same words as the Technology plan
- Folder structure matches the Developer guide tab (screens/, components/, providers/, routes/, l10n/)
